sn48.11:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti || saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhim ||
sn48.11:1.6: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho || pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn48.11:2.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave cattāro sammappadhāne ārabbha viriyam paṭilabhati || ||
sn48.11:3.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave cattaro satipaṭṭhāne ārabbha satim paṭilabhati || ||
sn48.11:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ || ||
sn48.11:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññaya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā || ||
